applied: Zoom limit saved. Use mouse wheel in game to zoom out.
restored: Original zoom limit restored. Move mouse wheel in game.
instructions: Saved limit applies automatically when game is detected. Keep toolkit running. Mouse-wheel speed stays unchanged.
close_restore_failed: Original limit could not be restored: {detail}
close_warning: Change may remain until game restarts.
original_above_cap: Original zoom limit exceeds 1000. Changing it is disabled.
saved_pending: Saved limit will apply when camera is available.
no_saved_limit: Choose a zoom limit; changes apply when released or with Apply for this session.
permanent_installed: Permanent mod installed — toolkit can be closed.
permanent_working: Updating game files… Keep toolkit open.
permanent_ready: Close game, then save permanently. Next game start uses this limit without toolkit.
permanent_find_game: Start game once so toolkit can locate installation.
permanent_removed: Mod and saved settings removed. Original zoom limit restored.
permanent_unknown: Installed mod status could not be read. Automatic connection is paused.
permanent_worker_failed: Mod operation stopped unexpectedly. Check installed files before continuing.
permanent_instructions: Permanent changes take effect after game restart. Toolkit is no longer needed while playing.
error.unsupported_build: Unsupported game version. No changes made
error.game_access_lost: Game access lost. Checking for running game again
error.game_not_found: Game not found. Start Star Trek: Outposts Unknown
error.multiple_games: Multiple game instances found. Leave only one open
error.already_connected: Another Subspace Toolkit is already connected to this game
error.loaded_code_mismatch: Loaded camera code does not match verified build. No changes made
error.camera_bounds: Camera values outside expected range. Access stopped
error.external_change: Zoom limit changed outside toolkit. Access stopped
error.camera_unavailable: No active game camera. Load a saved game
error.restore_camera_gone: Original camera no longer active. Restart game to fully reset
error.restore_external_change: External change detected; value left unchanged. Restart game to reset zoom
error.invalid_limit: Zoom limit must be between original value and 1000
error.game_must_close: Close game before installing or removing permanent mod
error.permanent_io: Could not read or write permanent mod files
error.permanent_manifest: Permanent mod installation record is invalid
error.permanent_conflict: Game files changed outside toolkit. Operation stopped to preserve those changes
error.permanent_backup: Original game backup is missing or invalid. Operation stopped
error.permanent_patch: Game data does not match expected zoom patch. Operation stopped
error.permanent_busy: Another permanent mod operation is running
error.permanent_incomplete: Installation incomplete or files changed. Close game and reset mod to recover.
reset_settings_failed: Zoom restored, but saved settings remain. Retry reset before restarting the game.
